name: Dot Camp
description: The Dot's flagship 1-year free hosting and incubation programme. Selected startups receive a fully equipped workspace, full-time access to meeting rooms, podcast and webinar studios, conference facilities, B2B networking with investors, and access to all Dot programmes including Executives in Residence. Annual cohort — applications open each year with selection in September. At least one founder must be based full-time in Tunisia. The programme actively connects founders with The Dot's 50+ SSO partners and 4 institutional partners throughout the year.
ideal_profile: Pre-seed or seed stage innovative startups with a working MVP and measurable early KPIs, committed full-time to their project, with at least one founder based in Tunisia. Readiness to contribute actively to the entrepreneurial community is required.
not_suited_for: Ideation-only founders with no MVP yet. Part-time entrepreneurs. Regional founders who cannot relocate to Tunis — Dot Camp+ is the right fit for them.
sequencing_note: Apply after achieving at least MVP and establishing early KPIs. Legal incorporation strengthens the application. Having initial customers or traction significantly improves selection chances. Mutually exclusive with Dot Camp+.
deliverables: Dedicated workspace, investor network access, all Dot programmes, studio access, cohort community
key_benefit: Free 1-year incubation with full workspace and investor network access

name: Dot Camp+
description: A 4-month pre-incubation and capacity-building programme for entrepreneurs in the ideation phase located outside the major coastal hubs (Tunis, Sousse, Sfax, Médenine). Includes intensive workshops, one-on-one coaching, pitch sprints, ecosystem immersion, and accommodation support in Tunis for up to one month to facilitate participation. Designed as the entry point into the Dot ecosystem for regional founders before they are ready for Dot Camp.
ideal_profile: Entrepreneurs based in remote or underrepresented regions of Tunisia with an innovative idea with high growth potential. No MVP required — idea stage is sufficient. Teams from outside the main coastal cities are prioritised.
not_suited_for: Tunis-based founders or founders already at seed stage with a working product — Dot Camp is the right fit for them. Not for founders who already have a validated product and customers.
sequencing_note: Apply at ideation stage before building the product. Dot Camp+ is the entry point that can lead to Dot Camp after the idea is validated. Mutually exclusive with Dot Camp.
deliverables: Intensive workshops, 1-on-1 coaching, pitch sprints, Tunis accommodation support
key_benefit: Dedicated path for regional (non-coastal) founders with ideation-stage ideas

name: Dot Landing
description: A free 4-month intensive incubation programme exclusively for Tunisian diaspora entrepreneurs wanting to launch or develop a business in Tunisia. Co-financed by Meet Africa 2 and the Île-de-France Region. Delivered via the THE DOT by Cynoia platform (BID/DotLanding programme). Includes personalised one-to-one expert sessions in legal, finance, strategy, and technology, collaborative workspace at The Dot, a digital platform with verified local service providers, and exclusive networking to integrate into the Tunisian entrepreneurial ecosystem. Experts include certified accountants, business law specialists, and sector advisors.
ideal_profile: Tunisian diaspora founders living or recently based abroad who have a specific business project they want to launch or establish in Tunisia. Also relevant for diaspora founders incorporated abroad seeking a local legal presence. The programme is particularly valuable for founders who need help navigating Tunisian business law, fiscal frameworks, and incorporation procedures.
not_suited_for: Non-diaspora founders. This programme is exclusively reserved for members of the Tunisian diaspora.
sequencing_note: Can run in parallel with Dot Expert which is particularly useful for diaspora founders navigating Tunisian incorporation and legal structure for the first time. Expert session in business law and accounting are included in the programme.
deliverables: 1-on-1 expert sessions (law, finance, strategy), workspace, local service provider platform, networking
key_benefit: Exclusive entry programme for Tunisian diaspora founders returning to launch in Tunisia

name: Dot Executives in Residence
description: A specialised mentorship initiative accessible to startups participating in Dot Camp. Connects founders with a curated pool of 25+ senior executives from tech, telecoms, commerce, industry, strategy consulting, private equity, and financial services. Structured as bi-monthly (twice a month) one-on-one and group sessions to challenge, advise, and help scale the business model. Mentors can advise on fundraising strategy, international expansion, team building, and investor relations.
ideal_profile: Founders already enrolled in Dot Camp with a working product and a concrete strategic challenge: scaling the team, entering a new market, preparing for investors, or navigating a pivot. Most impactful when there is something concrete to advise on.
not_suited_for: Founders not enrolled in Dot Camp — this programme is a sub-programme of Dot Camp and cannot be accessed independently. Ideation-only founders with no product or strategy to challenge.
sequencing_note: Access this after being accepted into Dot Camp. Most impactful at seed or early growth stage when strategic decisions have real consequences.
deliverables: Bi-monthly 1-on-1 sessions with C-level executives, group strategy sessions
key_benefit: Direct access to 25+ senior executives for strategic mentorship and investor introductions

name: Dot Expert
description: A one-to-one expert consultation service delivered via the THE DOT by Cynoia platform (Programme BID / DotLanding). Startups access certified senior experts on-demand in key domains: business law (legal structuring, shareholder agreements, IP, GDPR), financial engineering (business plan review, valuation, fundraising strategy, investor pitch preparation, financial modelling), strategy (go-to-market, competitive positioning, market entry), and technology. Each session is personalised to the specific needs of the founder. Sessions are documented and result in actionable recommendations. Used by startups preparing pitch decks for investment committees, structuring stock options, reviewing business plans, and building fundraising strategies.
ideal_profile: Startups at any stage that need expert advice in a specific domain: legal structure, fundraising preparation, business plan review, valuation, IP protection, or financial modelling. Particularly valuable for founders preparing to approach investors, signing commercial agreements, or structuring equity for a new team member.
not_suited_for: Founders who need broad ecosystem connections rather than specific expert advice — Dot Support or Dot Community Services are better fits. Founders looking for workspace rather than expert sessions.
sequencing_note: Use before major milestones: before incorporating, before fundraising, before signing a commercial contract, before submitting to an investment committee. Especially powerful when combined with Dot Camp or Dot Landing.
deliverables: Confidential 1-on-1 expert session, written recommendations, actionable plan
key_benefit: On-demand certified expert (accountant, lawyer, strategist) at your side for critical decisions

name: Dot Support
description: A programme designed to empower Startup Support Organisations (SSOs) and strengthen the entrepreneurial ecosystem by building meaningful connections between startups and ecosystem enablers such as incubators, accelerators, and institutional partners. The Dot has 50+ SSO partners with 4 institutional partners.
ideal_profile: Startups seeking structured connections with SSOs, incubators, accelerators, and institutional ecosystem partners. Useful for founders who need to navigate the broader Tunisian entrepreneurial support landscape and identify the right partners for their stage.
not_suited_for: Founders who already have strong SSO connections or who need direct product or technical support rather than ecosystem navigation.
sequencing_note: Most useful early on when the founder needs to map the ecosystem and identify the right support structures before committing to a specific programme.
deliverables: Access to 50+ SSO partners, institutional partner connections
key_benefit: Navigate the full Tunisian startup ecosystem with The Dot as your guide

name: Dot Community Services
description: A peer-to-peer sharing programme designed around co-construction: startups offer their services free of charge or at heavily discounted rates to other community members. Currently 12 community services available covering technology, recruitment, B2B tools, legal, and more. Active partners include Five Points (talent sourcing), Proservy (enterprise concierge), and Expensya (B2B efficiency).
ideal_profile: Startups already part of The Dot community who need affordable peer services to fill gaps in tech, recruitment, legal, or operations without the budget for external agencies. Also for startups willing to offer their own service to the community.
not_suited_for: Founders not yet engaged with The Dot community. Founders needing professional-grade external services beyond what peer startups can offer.
sequencing_note: Access at any stage once part of The Dot community. Most useful for early-stage founders managing tight budgets who need to move fast without spending on agencies.
deliverables: 12+ peer services (tech, recruitment, B2B tools, legal, design)
key_benefit: Access affordable or free services from fellow Dot community startups

name: AI Hub
description: A dedicated incubation space for AI startups, launched in partnership with InstaDeep. Provides access to high-performance computing infrastructure to train large ML models, direct mentorship from InstaDeep engineers and AI experts, deep learning and NLP workshops linked to the NVIDIA Partner Network, and international event sponsorship including travel and booths at major tech conferences like VivaTech. Founders must have a legally established startup, a working MVP with measurable KPIs, and demonstrate data-intensive use cases requiring serious compute scaling. Particularly suited for startups building proprietary AI models, SaaS AI platforms, or AI-powered industry solutions.
ideal_profile: AI or ML startups at pre-seed or seed stage with a working MVP and a data-intensive use case requiring compute infrastructure. Founders must demonstrate understanding of ML fundamentals and be operating full-time. Startup Act label is a strong advantage.
not_suited_for: Non-AI startups. Idea-only founders with no MVP or technical foundation. Startups whose AI component is superficial or cosmetic rather than core to the product.
sequencing_note: Most impactful after the technical core of the product is defined and the team has validated the use case. Can run alongside Dot Camp for startups needing both workspace and AI infrastructure.
deliverables: GPU compute access, InstaDeep mentorship, NVIDIA workshops, VivaTech sponsorship
key_benefit: High-performance computing + top-tier AI mentorship for deep tech founders

name: TECH216
description: A GIZ-backed IT outsourcing and nearshoring gateway connecting Tunisian tech companies with European (primarily German) corporate clients. Provides free matchmaking with international clients, co-working space at The Dot for up to 6 months to onboard nearshoring teams, legal and regulatory advisory on cross-border frameworks and IP, and inclusion in an official curated database of IT Sourcing Ready providers. Previous clients include BMW Group. Particularly relevant for B2B SaaS companies and IT service firms with international ambitions.
ideal_profile: Legally registered Tunisian IT or tech service companies with established capabilities in cloud computing, cybersecurity, software engineering, or mobile development. Must pass GDPR compliance and technical due diligence. Seed or growth stage with capacity to take on international client work.
not_suited_for: Non-tech startups or companies with no established service offering. Ideation-stage founders with no product or team. Startups not interested in the outsourcing or nearshoring market.
sequencing_note: Most relevant at seed or growth stage when the startup has a defined tech offering and actual capacity to deliver for international clients. Legal incorporation and GDPR awareness are prerequisites.
deliverables: EU client matchmaking, co-working space, IT Sourcing Ready certification, legal advisory
key_benefit: Direct access to European (German) corporate clients for B2B IT services
